newsitem.title: CHINA: Revlon to begin production of lipstick in China.
newsitem.headline: Revlon to begin production of lipstick in China.

text.p: Revlon Inc will begin production of its ColorStay brand of lipstick in Shanghai, marking the first manufacturing venture in China by the U.S. cosmetics company, Revlon said in a statement on Wednesday.
Revlon (Shanghai) Ltd, a joint venture with China's Sumstar Group, begin producing lipstick at a factory in Shanghai's Pudong New Area on May 14, the statement said.
The joint venture was formed in late 1996, it said. Revlon began selling lipstick in China in 1980 through a retail store in southern Guangdong province, the statement said.

The opening of the factory will help Revlon's expansion into the China market, since the company previously imported cosmetic products from the U.S. and then sold them through its Shanghai, Beijing and Guangzhou sales offices, it said.
